ValueType.description_en:
The value type of the parameter. Valid values:
ENUM: numeric enumeration.  
RANGE: numeric range.  
TIME: time.  
STRING: string.
ENUM_MULTIPLE: numeric enumeration with multiple selections.
CAPACITY: storage capacity value (K, M, G)

ENUM_MULTIPLE：数值枚举多选。
CAPACITY：存储容量值（K，M，G）
